name: Tiny Block Server
author: tinyblock@nosuchgames.com
description: Open-source headless dedicated server for persistent Tiny Block multiplayer worlds.

variables.name: Maximum Players
variables.description: Capacity advertised by this server. Player-hosted P2P worlds remain capped separately.

variables.name: Version
variables.description: GitHub release tag to install, such as v0.1.0, or latest.

variables.name: World ID
variables.description: Stable identifier used for the persistent world save.

variables.name: World Mode
variables.description: World generator: skyblock, floating_islands, procedural, one_block, or challenge_run.

variables.name: World Name
variables.description: Public name displayed in the Tiny Block server browser.

install.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl jq tar

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

REPOSITORY=hardtab/tinyblock-server
ASSET=tinyblock-server-linux-x86_64.tar.gz
if [ -z "${VERSION:-}" ] || [ "${VERSION}" = "latest" ]; then
    RELEASE_URL="https://api.github.com/repos/${REPOSITORY}/releases/latest"
else
    RELEASE_URL="https://api.github.com/repos/${REPOSITORY}/releases/tags/${VERSION}"
fi

RELEASE_JSON=$(curl -fsSL "${RELEASE_URL}")
DOWNLOAD_URL=$(printf '%s' "${RELEASE_JSON}" | jq -r --arg ASSET "${ASSET}" '.assets[] | select(.name == $ASSET) | .browser_download_url' | head -n 1)
CHECKSUM_URL=$(printf '%s' "${RELEASE_JSON}" | jq -r --arg ASSET "${ASSET}.sha256" '.assets[] | select(.name == $ASSET) | .browser_download_url' | head -n 1)

if [ -z "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" ] || [ "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" = "null" ] || [ -z "${CHECKSUM_URL}" ] || [ "${CHECKSUM_URL}" = "null" ]; then
    echo "Tiny Block Server release assets were not found for ${VERSION:-latest}." >&2
    exit 1
fi

curl -fsSL "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" -o "${ASSET}"
curl -fsSL "${CHECKSUM_URL}" -o "${ASSET}.sha256"
sha256sum -c "${ASSET}.sha256"
tar -xzf "${ASSET}" --strip-components=1 -C /mnt/server
rm -f "${ASSET}" "${ASSET}.sha256"
chmod +x /mnt/server/tinyblock-server.x86_64

echo "Tiny Block Server installation completed."
